title: Schwan Cosmetics to open new North Asia hub in Seoul to accelerate K-beauty innovation
summary: Due to open in January 2027, Schwan Cosmetics hub in Seoul, Korea, aims to bring K-beauty innovations in skin care and ingredients to colour cosmetics at a faster pace

extraction.key_fact: 슈완 코스메틱스가 서울에 북아시아 거점을 열고 K뷰티 혁신을 색조 화장품에 빠르게 접목한다.
